left-luggage.context: A suitcase beside a counter shelf with a claim tag on a string. Marks luggage storage desks in stations, airports, hotels and museums.

accessible-ramp.context: A wheelchair user rolling up a sloped ramp. Used for step free routes into buildings, platforms and public spaces.

family-restroom.context: An adult figure holding the hand of a small child. Marks family toilets and parent and child washrooms in malls, airports and restaurants.

accessible-toilet.context: A wheelchair symbol beside a side view toilet. Marks accessible toilets and washrooms with space and support rails.

phone-charging-station.context: A smartphone with a lightning bolt, connected by a cable to a wall mounted box. Marks public phone charging points in airports, cafes and malls.

stroller-parking.context: A baby stroller in side view with a letter P above it. Marks pram and stroller bays in shops, museums and transit stations.

quiet-zone.context: A head in profile with a finger held to the lips and a sound arc beside it. Marks quiet areas in libraries, trains and study spaces.

accessible-entrance.context: A wheelchair symbol facing an open doorway with a flat threshold. Shows the step free way into a building.

sensory-room.context: A square room outline with a beanbag on the floor and soft wavy light lines from the ceiling. Marks calming sensory spaces in schools, airports and hospitals.

adult-changing-room.context: A flat changing bench with a ceiling track and hoist sling above it. Marks adult changing facilities for people who need lifting support.

wheelchair-space.context: A wheelchair symbol inside floor corner marks. Shows the reserved bay for wheelchair users on trains, buses and in theaters.

fast-track-lane.context: A walking figure with double chevrons pointing ahead. Marks priority and fast lanes at airport security, events and attractions.

directory-board.context: A freestanding board listing floors as rows with level dots on its left edge. Used in lobbies, malls and hospitals to show what is on each floor.

occupancy-indicator.context: A lock plate with a window split in two, one half shaded. Shows whether a cubicle or toilet is free or taken.

staff-only-sign.context: A closed door with a small person wearing a lanyard badge. Marks doors that only employees may use.

reserved-table-card.context: A folded tent card standing on a table with a large letter R. Shows a table held for a booking in restaurants and cafes.

book-exchange-box.context: A small house shaped box on a post with books inside. Marks street libraries where neighbors leave and take books.

tax-refund.context: A shopping bag, a coin above it and a curved arrow pointing back to the bag. Marks tax free shopping and tourist refund counters.

women-only-car.context: A train carriage with a female figure in its window. Marks carriages set aside for women on metro and rail lines.

visitor-center.context: A small building with a pitched roof and a lowercase letter i. Marks tourist information points and visitor centers.

shoe-shine.context: A shoe in side view on a footrest block with a sparkle above the toe. Marks shoeshine stands and polishing services.

connecting-rooms.context: Two doors side by side with a double headed arrow across them. Marks hotel rooms that link through an internal door.

ski-storage.context: Two skis and two poles standing upright above a wall rack. Marks ski rooms and lockers at lodges and resorts.

beach-access.context: A walking figure above steps that lead down to wavy water, with a beach umbrella. Marks paths and stairs to the shore.

soundproof-room.context: A room outline with a speaker and sound arcs that stop at a thick wall. Marks acoustic booths, studios and noise isolated rooms.

ski-in-ski-out.context: A skier gliding toward a chalet with a pitched roof and door. Marks lodging that sits right on the ski slope.

infinity-pool.context: A pool outline with wavy water, a spill edge with falling lines and a horizon line above. Marks edge pools at hotels and resorts.

lazy-river.context: A person floating in a large ring above wavy water. Marks slow current rides at water parks and resorts.

outdoor-seating.context: A cafe table and two chairs under a tall round parasol. Marks terraces and open air dining areas.

umbrella-bag-dispenser.context: A wall dispenser next to a long plastic sleeve with a closed umbrella inside. Used at shop and office entrances on rainy days.

book-return-slot.context: A wall box with a slot and an open book standing halfway out. Marks drop boxes where borrowed books are returned.

cart-corral.context: A shopping cart parked inside a U shaped railing. Marks trolley bays in car parks and shop entrances.

shopping-basket-stack.context: Three V shaped baskets nested one above the other. Marks the spot where shoppers pick up a hand basket.

deliveries-entrance-sign.context: A door with two parcels stacked on a hand truck beside it. Marks goods in and delivery entrances.

pet-drinking-fountain.context: A low water bowl with a paw print above it, next to a tall fountain post. Marks water points for dogs in parks and plazas.

misting-station.context: A tall post with a nozzle at the top, mist dots in the air and a person standing below. Marks cooling stations at parks and events.

place-name-sign.context: A wide panel on two posts with a small house and lines of text. Marks town and village entry signs.

bicycle-counter.context: A tall display with a bicycle symbol above a row of digit boxes. Shows how many riders have passed on a bike path.

honesty-box.context: A small box with a coin slot and a padlock beside a crate with vegetables above it. Marks self service roadside stalls where people pay on trust.

roll-in-shower.context: A wheelchair symbol under a shower head with a flat floor. Marks showers with no step or tray edge.

accessible-hotel-room.context: A bed in side view beside a wheelchair symbol. Marks hotel rooms adapted for wheelchair users.

toilet-child-seat.context: A small seat with a toddler sitting in it, fixed beside a toilet stall wall. Marks stalls with a child seat for parents.

sanitary-bin.context: A slim pedal bin with a lid and a droplet mark on its front. Marks bins for sanitary waste in washrooms.

seat-cover-dispenser.context: A wall dispenser with a paper seat cover pulled out of the slot. Marks toilet seat cover dispensers in washrooms.

wheelchair-charging-point.context: A wheelchair symbol beside a lightning bolt and a ground line. Marks sockets for charging powered wheelchairs and scooters.

beach-access-mat.context: A wheelchair symbol on a flat mat with ribs under it. Marks rollout paths that let wheelchairs cross soft sand.

pool-hoist.context: A post with a swinging arm and a seat lowering toward wavy water. Marks lifts that move people in and out of pools.

wheelchair-swing.context: A swing frame with chains holding a flat platform and a wheelchair symbol on it. Marks inclusive swings in playgrounds.

lowered-counter.context: A service counter with one section stepped down and a wheelchair symbol above it. Marks desks that suit wheelchair users.

accessible-door-button.context: A square wall plate with a wheelchair symbol and a door outline. Marks the push button that opens an automatic door.

no-vaping-sign.context: A vape pen with puffs of vapor inside a ring with a slash. Shows that vaping is not allowed.

no-firearms-sign.context: A handgun shape inside a ring with a slash. Shows that guns are not allowed on the premises.

no-feeding-animals-sign.context: A duck and a piece of bread inside a ring with a slash. Shows that feeding animals is not allowed.

no-walking-on-grass-sign.context: A footprint above blades of grass inside a ring with a slash. Shows that people must keep off the lawn.

no-picking-flowers-sign.context: A flower on a stem with a leaf inside a ring with a slash. Shows that picking plants is not allowed.

no-selfie-sticks-sign.context: A phone on a long pole inside a ring with a slash. Shows that selfie sticks are banned.

no-tripods-sign.context: A camera on a three legged stand inside a ring with a slash. Shows that tripods are not allowed.

adults-only-sign.context: The number 18 inside a ring with a slash. Shows that the area or product is not for people under 18.

no-flushing-paper-sign.context: A sheet of paper dropping into a toilet bowl inside a ring with a slash. Shows that paper items must not be flushed.

no-hitchhiking-sign.context: A standing figure with an arm out and the thumb raised inside a ring with a slash. Shows that asking drivers for lifts is not allowed.

no-snowmobiles-sign.context: A snowmobile in side view inside a ring with a slash. Shows that motor sleds are not allowed on a trail or in an area.

no-off-road-vehicles-sign.context: A quad bike with four chunky wheels inside a ring with a slash. Shows that off road vehicles are not allowed.

no-throwing-objects-sign.context: A figure in a throwing pose with a small object leaving the hand, inside a ring with a slash. Shows that throwing things is not allowed.

no-sledding-sign.context: A figure seated on a sled inside a ring with a slash. Shows that sledding is not allowed on a slope.

no-knives-sign.context: A knife with the blade pointing up inside a ring with a slash. Shows that knives are not allowed.

no-lighters-sign.context: A lighter with a small flame inside a ring with a slash. Shows that lighters and open flames are not allowed.

no-laser-pointers-sign.context: A pen shaped laser pointer with a beam that ends in a dot inside a ring with a slash. Shows that laser pointers are not allowed.

no-chewing-gum-sign.context: A gum stick sliding out of a wrapper inside a ring with a slash. Shows that chewing gum is not allowed.

no-durian-sign.context: A round spiky durian fruit inside a ring with a slash. Shows that durian is not allowed because of its smell.

no-lying-down-sign.context: A figure lying flat above a bench inside a ring with a slash. Shows that lying or sleeping on seats is not allowed.

no-metal-detecting-sign.context: A figure with a metal detector disc sweeping the ground inside a ring with a slash. Shows that metal detecting is not allowed.

no-bill-posting-sign.context: A poster beside a paste brush inside a ring with a slash. Shows that sticking up posters and flyers is not allowed.

no-feet-on-seats-sign.context: A shoe resting on a seat cushion inside a ring with a slash. Shows that putting feet on seats is not allowed.

no-hoverboards-sign.context: A rider standing on a two wheeled self balancing board inside a ring with a slash. Shows that hoverboards are not allowed.

no-love-locks-sign.context: A padlock hooked over a railing inside a ring with a slash. Shows that attaching padlocks to bridges and fences is not allowed.
